lines.meet: I'm Giorgi, and I'm slow, and I don't talk much. You walk too fast, so slow down a little.
lines.meet_neighbour: Above Tarren Mill, yes, your smoke's on the next hill. I'm Giorgi, in the stone hut.
lines.ask_home: Your home, where is it? Tell me slowly.
lines.ask_work: What work did your hands do? I'd like to hear it.
lines.answer_home: Kazbegi, in the mountains of Georgia. My family kept sheep there longer than anybody wrote down.
lines.answer_work: I was a shepherd, twenty years. Every summer I took the flock up, six months, no road.
lines.chat_food: My wife's bread, from the clay oven, still hot. Nothing here is as good, and I've stopped trying.
lines.chat_sleep: On the mountain I slept with the dog against my back. Here there's no dog, and the nights are cold anyway.
lines.chat_missing: A good dog, and a fat flock on the hill. Some mornings I still look for them.
lines.chat_here: People here worry when you're alone. On my mountain, alone for weeks was normal, and it was good.
lines.tease_quiet: You're quiet, {name}, like me. We'll say a lot together without talking.
lines.tease_talker: So many words, {name}, all morning. I've been saving mine, so I'm rich now.
lines.tease_careful: You walk like a shepherd, {name}, slow and looking. Good, the ground likes you.
lines.tease_bold: You run at the hill, {name}, like a young ram. The hill always wins.
lines.tease_any: You're stubborn, {name}, like a good ewe. I like stubborn.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good, {name}. You made me laugh, which is hard.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's true, I think, {name}. My wife would agree.
lines.bristle: Not about that, {name}, please. I take it seriously.
lines.apologise: That was badly said, and I'm sorry for it. I've got few words, and I chose wrong ones.
lines.double_down: I chose those words carefully, and I'll keep them.
lines.needle_quiet: You see the wolf and say nothing. On the mountain, that loses the flock.
lines.needle_talker: Your words are like hail on the roof, all day. Please stop for a while.
lines.needle_careful: You wait too long, and the weather comes. A shepherd moves when it's time.
lines.needle_bold: You hurry everywhere, and the ground doesn't like it. One day it'll throw you.
lines.needle_any: You don't listen to the land, and you don't listen to me. I'm tired of saying it.
lines.bite_back: I've kept a flock alive on a mountain for twenty years. Don't tell me about care.
lines.hurt: Okay, that was heavy. I'll carry it up the hill for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My father said worse every summer, and the flock still came home. Come, let's walk.
lines.confide: {name}, every autumn I walk down the mountain like I'm bringing the flock home to my wife. You saw me, and you didn't ask why. I liked that.
lines.listen: I'm here, {name}. Say it slowly, there's time.
lines.look_out: Walk behind me in there, {name}. I'm big, and things hit me first.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, your way, and I'll follow.
lines.deflect: I'm a mountain, {name}, it's nothing. Help the others.
lines.check_in: Show me where it hurts, {name}. Slowly, I'm listening.
lines.blame: Somebody hurried, and the ground threw us all. You know who.
lines.thank: I was falling off the mountain, and you caught me. Thank you, I won't forget.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, it was easy. Sit, and breathe slowly.
lines.worry: My heart stopped when you fell, {name}. Sit with me a while.
lines.handed_down: This was on you before. I'll carry it well.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't need it. I've got my hands, and the ground.
lines.hand_sulk: Somebody could have asked. I'd have given it.
lines.turn_friendly: I like walking with you, {name}. You don't hurry me.
lines.turn_friends: You'd be welcome on my mountain, {name}, for the whole summer. I've never asked anyone that.
lines.turn_grating: We don't walk well together. That's all right, I'll go ahead.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll stand in front because I'm big. That's all it means.
lines.make_up: We were stubborn, both of us, {name}. Let's walk together again.
lines.defend: No, that's wrong, and I saw. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The hill is quiet without {name}. Quieter than I like, which is strange for me.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you came back. Walk with me.
lines.common_mountains: Twenty summers on the high pasture, six months with no road. The low ground still feels too heavy to me.
lines.common_animals: A shepherd is nothing without a good dog. I had the best one in Kazbegi, and I think about him every day.
lines.common_parent: I've got two girls, Ana and Mariam. Their mother thought I'd grow out of the mountain, and I never did.
